shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side. A woman in a navy blazer introduces the meeting agenda at the screen-side window seat, with a woman in a teal blouse at the screen-side walkway seat and a man in a burgundy polo at the door-side walkway seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the glass-door end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and both walkway-side seats in frame.

shots.content: A man in a mustard sweater enters, sits at the door-side window seat, and asks about the project timeline. A woman in a navy blazer answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A man in a burgundy polo asks about the next steps. A woman in a navy blazer replies with the schedule.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the presentation-screen end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the glass door, with both window-side seats and both walkway-side seats in frame.
